output.sql:
WITH units AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
  JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  WHERE o.is_revenue = true
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category
), ranked AS (
  SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, category, units_sold,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS rnk
  FROM units
)
SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, category, units_sold
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY product_id;
output.explanation: This query finds the product with the most units sold in 2025. It adds up the quantity on every order line from completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed between 2025-01-01 and 2025-12-31, and groups the totals by product. Cancelled, returned and open orders are left out. If several products tie for first place, all of them are returned.
